name: Lycoris Radiata
original_name: リコリス・ラジアータ
source:
Formerly [url=/c34610]Aoi's[/url] partner and an agent from Rubina, but now is [url=/c34612]Iris's[/url] familiar spirit. Since then, she holds a big scythe named "Crepusculefaux" which was provided by Iris. She is constantly coming up to [url=/c39402]Shuuma[/url] and causing trouble but retreats many times after Shuuma resists.

Lycoris is always energetic and acts like an idiot. [Spoiler]Everyone thinks this is just the evil effect of becoming a vampire, but it's not true. Unexpectedly though, people realize she was the brains behind daredevil Aoi when they were still a team.[/Spoiler]

[From [url=http://prefundia.com/projects/view/libra-of-the-vampire-princess-bishoujo-game-english-version/6962/]Prefundia[/url]]
